action_items.detail: My Phase 4 tests left records in the seeded Nexora org that cannot be removed, because the API has no endpoint to delete members or departments: department 'tscheck-dept-e686-r' (dep_9d9b370b461f, created and renamed) plus 4 'tscheck-' members (3 from early pytest runs, deactivated; 1 from the UI check 'tscheck-ui-*@example.com', added as an active Marketing employee). Because of this, two old global-count tests now fail: test_tscheck_overview_usage::test_filter_changes_and_org (it expects 12 employees and gets 16) and test_tscheck_p2_allocation::test_admin_view_and_over_budget_errors (it expects 4 departments and gets 5). These are not app bugs. Please remove the records by hand in Mongo, or change those tests to ignore 'tscheck-' rows. The pytest test now creates its members and departments in its own tscheck org. The UI check p4-team-add-member-login-deactivate still adds one Marketing member to Nexora per run, as the criterion requires.
Overview organization.employees appears to count deactivated members (16 includes 3 deactivated tscheck users). Please confirm this is intended.

The 'new request raises Sofia's count within ~30s without a reload' part was checked only through the API (the unread count goes up by 1 right away). Live polling in the UI was not observed in the browser.
